project_metadata.description: An enterprise-grade, full-stack Hospital Management System designed to digitize healthcare workflows, clinical operations, inpatient care, emergency triage, electronic prescriptions, diagnostics, pharmacy inventory, and billing.

components: Vanilla CSS3 Custom Dark Glassmorphic Design System
architectural_layers.responsibility: Renders responsive, role-based views, handles client-side telemetry rendering, and submits form/REST payloads.

components: Spring Boot 3.2.5 (Embedded Apache Tomcat on Port 8080)
Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) & Global Exception Handling
architectural_layers.responsibility: Executes domain workflows, access control verification, financial calculations, vital telemetry evaluation, and transactional management.

components: Aiven Cloud Managed MySQL or Local XAMPP MySQL Instance
Spring Data JPA Repositories (12 Interface Repositories)
Relational Schema (18 Relational SQL Tables & Analytical Views)
architectural_layers.responsibility: Ensures ACID-compliant transactional persistence for medical, clinical, financial, and administrative records.

design_patterns_used: Builder Pattern (Lombok-style custom static builders in entities)

backend_frameworks.security_framework: Spring Security 6 (BCrypt, Custom UserDetailsService, Role Authentication Provider)
backend_frameworks.file_io: Spring Multipart File Upload & NIO Path Storage

frontend_technologies.styling: Vanilla CSS3 with CSS Custom Properties (Variables), Flexbox, CSS Grid, and Glassmorphism
frontend_technologies.charting_engine: Chart.js (Doughnut, Curved Area, and Bar charts)
frontend_technologies.interactivity: Vanilla JavaScript ES6+ (Live ECG canvas simulation, darkroom image viewer, modal popups, real-time analytics polling)

database_technologies.schema_management: Hibernate DDL Auto (`update`) & Standalone SQL Dump (`Hospital_Management_Database_PUBLIC.sql`)

user_roles_and_access_control.role_system: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) via Spring Security

roles.description: Hospital Executive & System Administrator. Has full system configuration, staff onboarding, doctor directories, financial oversight, bed allocations, inventory monitoring, and complete access to all modules.

Consulting Physician / Specialist Doctor. Accesses clinical dashboard, appointments queue, electronic health records, diagnosis drafting, digital e-prescribing (Rx), diagnostic lab requests, and emergency trauma triage.
Front Desk & Admissions Staff. Handles patient intake & demographics, OPD appointment booking, IPD ward & bed allocations, patient discharges, invoice generation, and payment collections.

authentication_features: Unified Central Auth Hub (`/login` and `/register`) with role selector cards
Role-mismatch isolation guarding against unauthorized portal crossovers
BCrypt password hashing for credentials in the database
Stateful HTTP session management with JSESSIONID and secure invalidation on logout

core_modules.name: Authentication, Registration & User Management
core_modules.description: Multi-portal authentication system with role-specific login and registration pipelines, BCrypt password hashing, session control, and user profile management.
key_features: Unified Auth Hub with glassmorphic role selector cards
Dedicated portals for Administrator, Doctor, and Receptionist logins
Self-registration flows creating linked User and Doctor entities
Role mismatch detection and automatic redirection
Automated database seeding on initial boot via DataInitializer

core_modules.name: Executive & Role-Based Dashboards & Analytics
core_modules.description: Dynamic analytical command center delivering real-time hospital KPIs, revenue forecasting, bed occupancy monitoring, and interactive Chart.js visualizations.
key_features: Executive Admin Dashboard with hospital-wide financial, clinical, and operational metrics
Specialist Doctor Dashboard with daily consultation schedules, pending lab reports, and patient stats
Receptionist Front Desk Dashboard with rapid patient search, appointment check-ins, and ward occupancy
Chart.js interactive visualizations: 6-month revenue trends, bed occupancy doughnut, appointment pipeline
REST API endpoint (`/api/analytics/summary`) for live telemetry polling
Emergency broadcast ribbon alerting clinicians of active Code Red trauma cases

core_modules.name: Patient Management & Electronic Health Records (EHR)
core_modules.description: Comprehensive demographic and longitudinal clinical record system for inpatient and outpatient populations.
key_features: Patient registration with auto-generated hospital identification numbers
Demographic tracking: DOB, gender, blood group, emergency contacts, full address
Medical history and chronic allergy recording with visual badges
360-degree patient dossier viewing appointments, prescriptions, admissions, lab tests, and billing history
Real-time search and status filtering (Active / Inactive)

core_modules.name: Doctor Management & Clinical Directory
core_modules.description: Medical specialist cataloging, department classification, consulting fee management, and weekly availability scheduling.
key_features: Physician profile directory with qualifications, specializations, contact details, and assigned OPD room
Weekly schedule management (available days and consulting time slots)
Consultation fee configuration for automated billing generation
Linkage between Spring Security User accounts and clinical Doctor entities
Filtering by medical department and active/leave availability status

core_modules.name: Appointment Scheduling & OPD Workflow
core_modules.description: Real-time outpatient consultation booking connecting patients with specialist doctors.
key_features: OPD booking interface with date and time slot assignment
Conflict avoidance and doctor-specific appointment pipelines
Status workflow lifecycle: Scheduled -> Completed / Cancelled
Direct one-click transition from completed appointment to prescription drafting
Today's appointments quick filter and doctor-specific queueing

core_modules.name: Bed, Ward & Inpatient (IPD) Admission Management
core_modules.description: Complete inpatient facility management overseeing ward configurations, bed occupancy tracking, admissions, and discharge summaries.
key_features: Ward management supporting multiple ward categories (General, ICU, CCU, Private Suite, Maternity, Emergency)
Real-time bed tracking with status indicators (Available, Occupied, Maintenance) and daily room rates
Inpatient admission recording linking patient, bed, attending physician, and admission date
Discharge workflow calculating room charges and recording discharge notes and follow-up advice
Print-ready Inpatient Discharge Summary report generation

core_modules.name: Pharmacy & Medicine Inventory Management
core_modules.description: Pharmaceutical inventory control system managing medication stocks, batches, pricing, and automated restock workflows.
key_features: Comprehensive medicine master catalog (brand name, generic name, category, manufacturer)
Stock quantity tracking, reorder thresholds, and unit pricing
Batch number and expiration date tracking with shelf-life alerts
Automatic Low-Stock and Out-of-Stock alert banners
1-Click Quick Restock Modal with preset inventory increments (+10, +50, +100 units)

core_modules.name: Laboratory, Diagnostics & Medical Imaging
core_modules.description: Diagnostic test ordering, pathology result reporting, and medical scan archiving with darkroom radiographic viewer.
key_features: Diagnostic test catalog spanning Blood, Urine, Biochemistry, X-Ray, CT, MRI, Ultrasound, ECG, and Pathology
Diagnostic reading logging with reference normal ranges and clinical remarks
Digital scan and file attachment support (Chest X-Rays, Brain MRIs, Pathology PDFs)
Integrated Darkroom Radiography Scan Viewer with high-contrast presentation for radiological scans
Secure binary file streaming and downloading via FileStorageService (`/lab/download/{id}`)
Quick modal-based upload and removal of radiological attachments

core_modules.name: Digital Prescriptions (Rx) & E-Prescribing
core_modules.description: Clinical prescription drafting, medication schedule configuration, vital sign capture, and automated pharmacy dispensing.
key_features: Structured clinical Rx generation: chief complaints, diagnosis, symptoms, clinical vitals, general advice
Multi-item prescription scheduling: medication selection, dosage, frequency (e.g. 1-0-1), duration, instructions
Auto-generated unique prescription numbers (e.g. `RX-20261011-001`)
Print-ready Doctor's Rx Slip with hospital branding and signature block
1-Click Pharmacy Dispensing: automatically deducts medicine stock and creates a pending pharmacy bill

core_modules.name: Billing, Invoicing & Financial Settlement
core_modules.description: Automated healthcare billing calculating consultation, medication, diagnostic, and room charges with partial and full payment recording.
key_features: Comprehensive invoice builder itemizing doctor consultation, pharmacy drugs, lab tests, and room stay charges
Itemized bill line-item support (BillItem) with quantities, unit prices, and tax/discount calculations
Payment status lifecycle: Pending -> Partial -> Paid
Multi-channel payment recording: Cash, Credit/Debit Card, UPI, Health Insurance
Printable hospital invoice with breakdown and balance due calculation
Revenue analytics tracking total billed, total collected, and outstanding receivables

core_modules.name: Emergency, Trauma & Manchester Triage Command Center
core_modules.description: High-acuity 24/7 trauma intake command center implementing 5-level Manchester Triage protocol, real-time vitals telemetry, continuous ECG rhythm simulation, and ICU escalations.
key_features: 24/7 Rapid Emergency Trauma Intake supporting registered patients or unidentified walk-in/unconscious trauma victims
5-Level Manchester Triage protocol: Code Red (Immediate/Resuscitation), Code Orange (Very Urgent), Code Yellow (Urgent), Code Green (Standard), Code Blue (Non-Urgent)
Real-time biometric vital telemetry tracking: BP, Heart Rate, SpO2, Respiratory Rate, Temp, Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS 3-15), Blood Glucose, Pain Score (1-10)
Live animated continuous Lead II ECG rhythm oscilloscope canvas in glassmorphic monitor
Fast resuscitation intervention logging and treatment timeline recording
Seamless 1-click bed escalation to ICU or emergency observation wards
Persistent emergency broadcast banner across executive dashboards for Code Red emergencies

design_characteristics: Dark glassmorphic aesthetic using backdrop-filter blur and semi-transparent RGBA borders
Vibrant semantic color coding: Emergency Red (#ef4444), Amber (#f59e0b), Emerald Green (#10b981), Cyan (#06b6d4), Violet (#8b5cf6)
Darkroom Radiography viewer for high-contrast viewing of X-Ray, CT, and MRI scans
Lead II continuous ECG simulated canvas animation with pulsing heart rate audio-visual feedback
Print-optimized stylesheets (`@media print`) hiding navigational chrome on Rx slips, invoices, and discharge summaries

prerequisites: Java Development Kit (JDK) 17 or higher (tested up to JDK 25)
MySQL Server 8.0+ / MariaDB (e.g. via XAMPP Control Panel) or Aiven Cloud MySQL
Git CLI & Modern Web Browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari)

local_xampp.step_1: Start the MySQL module in XAMPP Control Panel (Port 3306).
local_xampp.step_2: Spring Boot will automatically create the `hospital_db` database if not present.
local_xampp.step_3: Optionally import `Hospital_Management_Database_PUBLIC.sql` via phpMyAdmin or MySQL Workbench if manual initialization is desired.

aiven_cloud.step_1: Obtain cloud database credentials from Aiven Console.
